page_title: REN 1-0 REI | Rennes v Reims 21/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Rennes take a short corner kick.
90+3' Hans Hateboer (Rennes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
90+1' Kazeem Olaigbe (Rennes) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
87' Reims couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Steve Mandanda (Rennes) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
85' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
83' The corner is swung in but Rennes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
79' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) for his blatant foul.
78' Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Yehvann Diouf is alert and makes a decent save.
76' Ismael Kone (Rennes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
75' Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
74' Substitution. Lorenz Assignon makes his way off the pitch and Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) comes on as his replacement.
73' Samba Diawara has decided to substitute Nhoa Sangui and he is replaced by Buta (Reims).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) will replace Junya Ito.
72' A lofted pass into the box is met by Keito Nakamura (Reims), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
69' That's a well-taken pass by Lilian Brassier (Rennes). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
68' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Reims, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
66' Nhoa Sangui (Reims) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
64' Nhoa Sangui (Reims) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
61' Here comes a substitution. Teddy Teuma is given a rest as he is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Seko Fofana trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ismael Kone (Rennes).
61' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kazeem Olaigbe (Rennes) replacing Mousa Tamari.
60' The corner kick from Keito Nakamura (Reims) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
59' Keito Nakamura (Reims) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Reims are awarded a corner kick.

57' Seko Fofana (Rennes) loses the defending players and unloads a powerful, but inaccurate effort from long distance. The goalkeeper remains completely calm as the ball ends somewhere in row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
56' Yehvann Diouf pulls off a fantastic save! Seko Fofana (Rennes) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
54' Reims have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
52' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.
49' An attempted cross from Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) is cleared.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Samba Diawara gives a chance to John Joe Patrick Finn and Amadou Kone (Reims) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Oumar Diakite (Reims) comes off for Valentin Atangana Edoa.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Oumar Diakite (Reims) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.

45' The ball is crossed into the box and Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom right corner, but Yehvann Diouf gets a glove on it to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Rennes.
44' Rennes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

44' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Jordan James (Rennes) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rennes.
42' The ball is cleared after Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
38' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
37' Keito Nakamura (Reims) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
35' That was close. Hans Hateboer (Rennes) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
32' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' Yehvann Diouf comes off his line to intercept the corner from Jordan James (Rennes).

30' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
29' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 57:43.
26' Jordan James (Rennes) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
25' Rennes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
24' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
21' Jordan James (Rennes) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
21' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Rennes.
19' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
18' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
16' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

16' A pass lands at the feet of Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
14' Teddy Teuma (Reims) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
10' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Yehvann Diouf no chance!
10' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
9' The players claim that Amadou Kone (Reims) handled the ball and it seems they are right. No point in arguing there. Rennes will take a penalty kick.
8' Rennes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
7' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Rennes have a corner.
5' Cedric Kipre (Reims) is shown a red card by the referee for a horror tackle that simply has no place in football!

4' What a chance that is! Adrien Truffert (Rennes) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
2' Seko Fofana (Rennes) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Reims will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Marc Bollengier.
